name: Narrative and flow tracker

description.model: Tracks what people say about Monad on X and the web, now. Use when gauging attention and whether a story is rising.
description.marketplace: Rising, peaking and fading narratives about Monad and MON from X and the web, with velocity and the difference between signal and noise. Supply unlocks come after the beta (D-302).

triggers: gauging sentiment or attention around Monad
checking whether a story is new or recycled
not_for: confirming facts, which need primary sources
